messages:
Mia G: quick sync 1 team: need social plan for next Wed launch + webinar (11am PT). Can we finalize copy, assets, schedule & routing by EOD?

Devin P: I can draft copy. Plan: 4-post X thread + 2 LinkedIn variants (product-led + benchmark-led). Will A/B headlines and let paid favor winner.

Samir K: design can deliver hero + 6s perf GIF + 3 quote cards. ETA first comps 2pm PT. Need the exact numbers CSV and approved quotes.

Jordan T: benchmark TL;DR: up to 42% p95 latency reduction, up to 30% cost/unit improvement (workload-aware batching + quant). Use "up to" and include sample size in LI longform.

Lina S: tracking: add utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=launch_3_31. Paid uses utm_medium=paid&utm_campaign=launch_3_31_paid. Hidden form field company_size_bracket for SDR routing.

Lina S: SDR routing rules: enterprise or ARR >= 1,000,000 -> SDR-enterprise; ARR 250k-999k -> SDR-midmarket; else -> nurture.

Devin P: X thread draft (compact):
1) Were shipping runtime updates that cut latency & cost for production LLMs.
2) In tests, teams saw up to 42% lower p95 latency vs baseline.
3) Up to 30% lower cost/unit via batching + quantization.
4) Join our webinar 3/31 11am PT for demos + Q&A  https://redwood.ai/webinar (pinned TL;DR).

Mia G: add one sentence about same API across hosted, dedicated, private. Add line on deterministic fallbacks.

Samir K: uploaded v1 assets to drive/design/launch-assets. Will push final GIF v2 when quotes are approved.

Jordan T: customers: 1 verbatim OK, 1 anonymized, 1 reviewing. Sending consent to legal now.

MarketingBot: Reminder: "Launch assets + routing rules due by EOD"

Devin P: scheduling CSV ready to go; will swap final copy & media once legal clears. Posting windows: 11:00 PT (live/pinned), 15:00 PT (boost), 08:00 PT next day (APAC).

Mia G: checklist: copy (Devin) [x], assets (Samir) [in progress], approvals (Jordan) [in progress], UTMs & workflow (Lina) [x], paid audience & budget (Lina) [x]. Aim to finish scheduling by 6pm PT.

Devin P: Ill queue once legal OKs quotes and drop post IDs here. SDRs: monitor assigned leads within 24h. Thanks team!
